mentions.name: Photo reverse geocoding travel planner
mentions.description: This app reverse geocodes the user's photos and screenshots of places saved from TikTok/Instagram, extracts itineraries from past trips, and uses that data to ground LLM-powered travel recommendations, such as generating a week of plans for bookmarked places in one city based on what the user enjoyed in another.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building an app to reverse geocode all the photos I've taken and screenshots of places I want to go from TikTok/Instagram.

Use cases are extracting the itineraries I took from prior trips, then using that to ground LLM search recommendations: I have a set of bookmarked places, say in NYC, can you make me a week of plans given what I enjoyed in Taipei?
